case.title: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG. Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings. Need: 8150 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 45 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200001. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70110.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
sup:70110.subject: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
sup:70110.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. For many years, our family foundry has taken great pride in supplying your respected company with high-quality castings from our region, and we value our long standing relationship very much.

Our team has prepared our offer carefully. We can offer you a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

To remain transparent about our situation, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. We trust that you understand the necessity of these figures for our ongoing operation and quality standards.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

message.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
message.body:
Dear Mr Brandlhuber,

You wrote that your family foundry takes pride in supplying us with castings from our region, and we feel the same about our side of this relationship. We have not forgotten that you held the old price for us in a hard year. That is why we want to answer your offer with a fair solution for both family companies.

Two points need to be settled first.

On the notice period:
Your letter of 11 September 2026 (doc:20260911-70110-P01) gives 51 days' notice, while our contract (ctr:4600070110) requires 90 days.

On quality:
Your quality was 712 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70110@2026Q3).

Against that background, we put the following options in front of you:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 132.33; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 45 days net.
Option B: unit price EUR 133.08; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 60 days net.
Option C: unit price EUR 134.57; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 90 days net.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives your foundry a clear, reliable price from the new date, and it shows the reciprocity you expect from a partner.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
message.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
message.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We also checked the notice period data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. We are willing to accept your requested 45-day payment terms, provided we set the effective date to 1 January 2027 to properly reflect the contractual notice period rather than delaying until April. 

Our current Angebot is a price of €138.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. Alternatively, with valid from 1 January 2027: a price of €135.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, valid from 1 January 2027. 

Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

message.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
message.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We did not know that - a fair point. However, absorbing the rising costs over these years is no longer sustainable for our family foundry. 

Building on your Option B, we can offer €135.50 per unit with the 14-day payment term. To set out all the details, our offer reflects a price of €135.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days.

Our long relationship with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH means a great deal to us, and we take deep pride in the craft and dedication of our people here at the foundry. We trust this proposal provides a practical path forward for both of our companies.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. We have received your latest options, but a one-cent adjustment does not constitute the realistic step forward we requested.

message.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
message.body:
Guten Tag,

We appreciate the slight adjustment in your offer, but it is still far from a sustainable level for our foundry. Our family business takes immense pride in the craftsmanship and dedication of our people, and to safeguard this quality for our region over the long term, we must stand firm on our calculations.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. We must maintain our offer of a price of €135.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. This offer stays valid for 7 days.

We look forward to our phone call to discuss this personally and find a fair solution for both family companies.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

move.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
move.body:
Dear Mr Brandlhuber,

You asked for a realistic step forward, and we are glad you accept a personal call. We have not forgotten that your foundry held the old price for us in a hard year, and we want to answer that as one family company to another.

Our line has not changed: on price we remain firm. What we have done is give you a choice, so that you can pick the terms that suit your foundry best.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 131.11; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 14 days net.
Option B: unit price EUR 131.90; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 30 days net.
Option C: unit price EUR 132.64; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 45 days net.

Option A is the package we can approve. That seems to us a fair solution for both family companies.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away. We would be pleased to talk it through by phone as well, if you prefer.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We appreciate the slight adjustment in your offer, but it is still far from a sustainable level for our foundry. Our family business takes immense pride in the craftsmanship and dedication of our people, and to safeguard this quality for our region over the long term, we must stand firm on our calculations.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. We must maintain our offer of a price of €135.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. This offer stays valid for 7 days.

We look forward to our phone call to discuss this personally and find a fair solution for both family companies.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
